---
title: "Season Forecasts"
page-layout: custom
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: build-forecasts-payload
#| results: asis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(jsonlite)
})

payload_path <- file.path("data", "season_forecasts_payload.rds")
if (!file.exists(payload_path)) {
  stop("season_forecasts_payload.rds not found in quarto_site/data/.")
}

forecast_payload <- readRDS(payload_path)

cat(sprintf(
  "\n```{=html}\n<script id=\"forecasts-payload\" type=\"application/json\">%s</script>\n```\n",
  jsonlite::toJSON(forecast_payload, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)
))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const rawJson = document.getElementById("forecasts-payload").textContent;
  const payload = JSON.parse(rawJson);
  const leaguesMap = payload.leagues || {};

  const flagMap = {
    "NWSL": "\uD83C\uDDFA\uD83C\uDDF8",
    "USL Super League": "\uD83C\uDDFA\uD83C\uDDF8",
    "WSL": "\uD83C\uDFF4\uDB40\uDC67\uDB40\uDC62\uDB40\uDC65\uDB40\uDC6E\uDB40\uDC67\uDB40\uDC7F",
    "Liga F": "\uD83C\uDDEA\uD83C\uDDF8",
    "Premi\u00e8re Ligue": "\uD83C\uDDEB\uD83C\uDDF7",
    "Frauen-Bundesliga": "\uD83C\uDDE9\uD83C\uDDEA",
    "Serie A": "\uD83C\uDDEE\uD83C\uDDF9",
    "A-League": "\uD83C\uDDE6\uD83C\uDDFA"
  };

  window.switchFcTab = function(tab) {
    const tabs = ["standings", "leverage", "points", "cutline"];
    tabs.forEach(t => {
      document.getElementById("fc-panel-" + t).style.display = (t === tab) ? "block" : "none";
      document.getElementById("fc-tab-btn-" + t).classList.toggle("active", t === tab);
    });
  };

  window.downloadFcCanvas = function(canvasId, filename) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.download = filename;
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    link.click();
  };

  window.downloadDomTable = function(boxId, filename) {
    const el = document.getElementById(boxId);
    if (!el) return;
    html2canvas(el, { backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF", scale: 2 }).then(canvas => {
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.download = filename;
      link.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
      link.click();
    });
  };

  // Cube-root teal color scale matching nwsl_predictive_pipeline.R
  function posColorScale(val) {
    const v = Number(val);
    if (isNaN(v) || v <= 0) return { bg: "transparent", fg: "transparent" };
    const norm = Math.pow(Math.min(Math.max(v / 100, 0), 1), 0.333);
    const bg = `rgba(0, 116, 122, ${norm.toFixed(4)})`;
    const fg = (v >= 2.0) ? "#EEEDCE" : "rgba(0, 116, 122, 0.32)";
    return { bg, fg };
  }

  function playoffColorScale(pctVal) {
    const v = Number(pctVal);
    if (isNaN(v)) return { bg: "transparent", fg: "#00747A" };
    const norm = Math.min(Math.max(v / 100, 0), 1);
    const bg = `rgba(0, 116, 122, ${norm.toFixed(4)})`;
    const fg = (v >= 25.0) ? "#EEEDCE" : "#00747A";
    return { bg, fg };
  }

  // 1. Render Standings & Playoff Matrix
  function renderStandingsMatrix(lgData) {
    const box = document.getElementById("standings-export-box");
    const rows = lgData.standings_table || [];
    const numTeams = Number(lgData.num_teams) || rows.length || 16;
    const cutSpot  = Number(lgData.playoff_spots) || 8;

    document.getElementById("standings-title").textContent =
      `${lgData.league_name} ${lgData.season_label || ""} Final Standings & Playoff Probability Matrix`;

    let html = `<ta` + `ble class="fc-matrix-table">
        <thead>
          <tr class="fc-group-row">
            <th></th>
            <th colspan="${numTeams}">Final Standings Place Probability (%)</th>
            <th style="border-left: 2.5px solid #00747A;"></th>
          </tr>
          <tr class="fc-col-row">
            <th style="text-align: left; width: 210px;"></th>`;

    const cutLabel = lgData.cut_label || "Playoffs (%)";
    for (let p = 1; p <= numTeams; p++) {
      const cutBorder = (p === cutSpot) ? "border-right: 1px dashed rgba(0, 116, 122, 0.45);" : "";
      html += `<th style="${cutBorder}">${p}</th>`;
    }
    html += `<th style="border-left: 2.5px solid #00747A; width: 118px;">${cutLabel}</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;

    rows.forEach(r => {
      const logoImg = r.logo_b64
        ? `<img class="fc-team-logo" src="${r.logo_b64}" alt="">`
        : "";
      html += `<tr><td><div class="fc-team-cell">${logoImg}<span>${r.team}</span></div></td>`;

      for (let p = 1; p <= numTeams; p++) {
        const val = Number(r[String(p)]) || 0;
        const cutBorder = (p === cutSpot) ? "border-right: 1px dashed rgba(0, 116, 122, 0.45);" : "";
        if (val <= 0) {
          html += `<td style="text-align: center; ${cutBorder}"></td>`;
        } else {
          const st = posColorScale(val);
          html += `<td style="text-align: center; background-color: ${st.bg}; color: ${st.fg}; ${cutBorder}">${val.toFixed(2)}</td>`;
        }
      }

      const poSt = playoffColorScale(r.playoff_pct);
      html += `<td style="text-align: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; border-left: 2.5px solid #00747A; background-color: ${poSt.bg}; color: ${poSt.fg};">${r.playoff_display}</td></tr>`;
    });

    html += `</tbody></table>`;
    box.innerHTML = html;
  }

  // 2. Render Matchday Playoff Leverage Table
  function renderLeverageTable(lgData) {
    const box = document.getElementById("leverage-export-box");
    const rows = lgData.leverage_table || [];

    document.getElementById("leverage-title").textContent =
      `${lgData.league_name} Matchday Playoff Leverage & Viewer's Guide`;

    if (rows.length === 0) {
      box.innerHTML = `<p style="padding: 1.5rem; color: #555555; font-size: 1rem; margin: 0;">All regular-season fixtures for the ${lgData.season_label || ""} ${lgData.league_name} season have been completed.</p>`;
      return;
    }

    let maxLev = 1;
    rows.forEach(r => {
      const v = Number(r.total_leverage) || 0;
      if (v > maxLev) maxLev = v;
    });

    let html = `<ta` + `ble class="fc-matrix-table" style="font-size: 17px;">
        <thead>
          <tr class="fc-group-row">
            <th></th>
            <th colspan="3">Matchup</th>
            <th colspan="2">Home Stakes (Loss &harr; Win)</th>
            <th colspan="2">Away Stakes (Loss &harr; Win)</th>
            <th style="border-left: 2.5px solid #00747A;">Stakes</th>
          </tr>
          <tr class="fc-col-row">
            <th style="width: 90px;">Date</th>
            <th style="text-align: left; width: 240px;">Home Club</th>
            <th style="width: 185px;">Home | Draw | Away</th>
            <th style="text-align: left; width: 240px;">Away Club</th>
            <th style="width: 165px;">Playoff Range</th>
            <th style="width: 95px;">Swing</th>
            <th style="width: 165px;">Playoff Range</th>
            <th style="width: 95px;">Swing</th>
            <th style="border-left: 2.5px solid #00747A; width: 135px;">Total Leverage</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>`;

    rows.forEach((r, idx) => {
      const rowBg = (idx % 2 === 1) ? "background-color: #F9FAFB;" : "";
      const hLogo = r.home_logo_b64 ? `<img class="fc-lev-logo" src="${r.home_logo_b64}" alt="">` : "";
      const aLogo = r.away_logo_b64 ? `<img class="fc-lev-logo" src="${r.away_logo_b64}" alt="">` : "";

      const hSwingVal = Number(r.h_swing) || 0;
      const aSwingVal = Number(r.a_swing) || 0;
      const hSwingStr = hSwingVal > 0 ? `+${hSwingVal.toFixed(1)}%` : "--";
      const aSwingStr = aSwingVal > 0 ? `+${aSwingVal.toFixed(1)}%` : "--";
      const hSwingCol = hSwingVal >= 15.0 ? "#00747A" : "#666666";
      const aSwingCol = aSwingVal >= 15.0 ? "#00747A" : "#666666";

      const totLev = Number(r.total_leverage) || 0;
      const normLev = Math.min(Math.max(totLev / maxLev, 0), 1);
      const levBg = totLev > 0 ? `rgba(0, 116, 122, ${(normLev * 0.85).toFixed(4)})` : "transparent";
      const levFg = normLev > 0.45 ? "#EEEDCE" : "#00747A";

      html += `
        <tr style="${rowBg}">
          <td style="text-align: center; color: #444444; padding: 10px 12px;">${r.date}</td>
          <td style="padding: 10px 12px;"><div class="fc-team-cell" style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px;">${hLogo}<span>${r.home}</span></div></td>
          <td style="text-align: center; color: #555555; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; padding: 10px 12px;">${r.match_odds}</td>
          <td style="padding: 10px 12px;"><div class="fc-team-cell" style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px;">${aLogo}<span>${r.away}</span></div></td>
          <td style="text-align: center; padding: 10px 12px;">${r.h_range}</td>
          <td style="text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: ${hSwingCol}; padding: 10px 12px;">${hSwingStr}</td>
          <td style="text-align: center; padding: 10px 12px;">${r.a_range}</td>
          <td style="text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: ${aSwingCol}; padding: 10px 12px;">${aSwingStr}</td>
          <td style="text-align: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; border-left: 2.5px solid #00747A; background-color: ${levBg}; color: ${levFg}; padding: 10px 12px;">${totLev.toFixed(1)}%</td>
        </tr>`;
    });

    html += `</tbody></table>`;
    box.innerHTML = html;
  }

  // 3. Render Simulated Standings Points Distribution Raster Canvas
  function drawPointsDistCanvas(lgData) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById("points-dist-canvas");
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const W = canvas.width;
    const H = canvas.height;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#00747A";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const ptsRows = lgData.points_dist || [];
    if (ptsRows.length === 0) return;

    const teamsTopDown = Array.isArray(lgData.team_order) && lgData.team_order.length > 0
      ? lgData.team_order
      : Array.from(new Set(ptsRows.map(r => r.team)));

    const nTeams = teamsTopDown.length;

    let minPts = Infinity, maxPts = -Infinity, maxCount = 1;
    const peakByTeam = {};

    ptsRows.forEach(r => {
      const p = Number(r.total_points);
      const c = Number(r.count);
      if (p < minPts) minPts = p;
      if (p > maxPts) maxPts = p;
      if (c > maxCount) maxCount = c;

      if (!peakByTeam[r.team] || c > peakByTeam[r.team].count) {
        peakByTeam[r.team] = { total_points: p, count: c };
      }
    });

    const padLeft = 360;
    const padRight = 50;
    const padTop = 45;
    const padBottom = 140;
    const plotW = W - padLeft - padRight;
    const plotH = H - padTop - padBottom;

    const nCols = Math.max(1, maxPts - minPts + 1);
    const cellW = plotW / nCols;
    const cellH = plotH / nTeams;

    // Interpolate [#00747A (0,116,122) -> #EEEDCE (238,237,206)]
    function countToColor(c) {
      const t = Math.min(Math.max(c / maxCount, 0), 1);
      const r = Math.round(0 + t * 238);
      const g = Math.round(116 + t * (237 - 116));
      const b = Math.round(122 + t * (206 - 122));
      return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
    }

    // Draw raster cells
    ptsRows.forEach(r => {
      const tIdx = teamsTopDown.indexOf(r.team);
      if (tIdx < 0) return;
      const p = Number(r.total_points);
      const c = Number(r.count);
      const colIdx = p - minPts;

      const x = padLeft + colIdx * cellW;
      const y = padTop + tIdx * cellH;

      ctx.fillStyle = countToColor(c);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, Math.ceil(cellW), Math.ceil(cellH));
    });

    // Draw modal total_points text on peak cell per team
    ctx.fillStyle = "#00747A";
    ctx.font = "700 24px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    teamsTopDown.forEach((tm, tIdx) => {
      const pk = peakByTeam[tm];
      if (!pk) return;
      const colIdx = pk.total_points - minPts;
      const cx = padLeft + (colIdx + 0.5) * cellW;
      const cy = padTop + (tIdx + 0.5) * cellH;
      ctx.fillText(String(pk.total_points), cx, cy);
    });

    // Axes lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padLeft, padTop);
    ctx.lineTo(padLeft, padTop + plotH);
    ctx.lineTo(padLeft + plotW, padTop + plotH);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Y-axis Team Names
    ctx.fillStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.font = "400 26px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    teamsTopDown.forEach((tm, tIdx) => {
      const cy = padTop + (tIdx + 0.5) * cellH;
      ctx.fillText(tm, padLeft - 16, cy);
    });

    // X-axis Ticks & Labels
    ctx.font = "400 26px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    const step = nCols > 25 ? 5 : 2;
    const firstTick = Math.ceil(minPts / step) * step;
    for (let p = firstTick; p <= maxPts; p += step) {
      const colIdx = p - minPts;
      const tx = padLeft + (colIdx + 0.5) * cellW;
      ctx.fillText(String(p), tx, padTop + plotH + 14);
    }

    // X-axis Title
    ctx.font = "700 32px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Simulated Standings Points", padLeft + plotW / 2, padTop + plotH + 62);
  }

  // 4. Render Playoffs Cut-Line Distribution Bar Chart Canvas
  function drawCutlineCanvas(lgData) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById("cutline-canvas");
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const W = canvas.width;
    const H = canvas.height;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#00747A";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const cutRows = lgData.playoff_lines || [];
    if (cutRows.length === 0) return;

    let minPts = Infinity, maxPts = -Infinity, maxCount = 1;
    cutRows.forEach(r => {
      const p = Number(r.total_points);
      const c = Number(r.count);
      if (p < minPts) minPts = p;
      if (p > maxPts) maxPts = p;
      if (c > maxCount) maxCount = c;
    });

    const yMax = maxCount + 2000;
    const xMin = minPts - 0.5;
    const xMax = maxPts + 0.5;

    const padLeft = 95;
    const padRight = 50;
    const padTop = 175;
    const padBottom = 135;
    const plotW = W - padLeft - padRight;
    const plotH = H - padTop - padBottom;

    // Title & Subtitle
    const cutTitle = lgData.cut_title || `${lgData.league_name} Playoffs Cut Lines`;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.font = "700 52px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(cutTitle, padLeft, 28);

    ctx.font = "400 38px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Simulating the Season 100,000 Times", padLeft, 95);

    const unitW = plotW / (xMax - xMin);
    const barW = unitW * 0.90;
    const labelFontPx = Math.min(28, Math.max(15, Math.floor(barW * 0.36)));

    cutRows.forEach(r => {
      const p = Number(r.total_points);
      const c = Number(r.count);
      const centerX = padLeft + ((p - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * plotW;
      const barH = (c / yMax) * plotH;
      const barX = centerX - barW / 2;
      const barY = padTop + plotH - barH;

      ctx.fillStyle = "#EEEDCE";
      ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);

      const nudgeY = Math.max(6, (800 / yMax) * plotH);
      ctx.font = `400 ${labelFontPx}px 'Assistant', sans-serif`;
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
      ctx.fillText(String(c), centerX, barY - nudgeY);
    });

    // Axes lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padLeft, padTop);
    ctx.lineTo(padLeft, padTop + plotH);
    ctx.lineTo(padLeft + plotW, padTop + plotH);
    ctx.stroke();

    // X-axis Integer Labels
    ctx.fillStyle = "#EEEDCE";
    ctx.font = "700 32px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    for (let p = minPts; p <= maxPts; p++) {
      const tx = padLeft + ((p - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * plotW;
      ctx.fillText(String(p), tx, padTop + plotH + 16);
    }

    // X-axis Title
    ctx.font = "700 38px 'Assistant', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Final Points Total", padLeft + plotW / 2, padTop + plotH + 70);

    // Y-axis Title
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(32, padTop + plotH / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("Number of Simulations", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function renderActiveLeague() {
    const lgKey = document.getElementById("fc-league-val").value;
    const lgData = leaguesMap[lgKey];
    if (!lgData) return;

    document.getElementById("fc-updated-text").textContent =
      lgData.updated_at ? `Updated: ${lgData.updated_at}` : "";

    renderStandingsMatrix(lgData);
    renderLeverageTable(lgData);
    drawPointsDistCanvas(lgData);
    drawCutlineCanvas(lgData);
  }

  function initLeagueSelector() {
    const keys = Object.keys(leaguesMap);
    const hiddenEl = document.getElementById("fc-league-val");
    const trigger  = document.getElementById("fc-league-trigger");
    const menu     = document.getElementById("fc-league-menu");

    if (keys.length === 0) return;
    if (!leaguesMap[hiddenEl.value]) hiddenEl.value = keys[0];

    const renderTrigger = (k) => {
      const flag = flagMap[k] || "\uD83C\uDFF3\uFE0F";
      trigger.innerHTML = `<span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.45rem;"><span class="fc-flag">${flag}</span><span>${k}</span></span>`;
    };

    renderTrigger(hiddenEl.value);
    menu.innerHTML = "";

    keys.forEach(k => {
      const flag = flagMap[k] || "\uD83C\uDFF3\uFE0F";
      const opt = document.createElement("div");
      opt.className = "fc-select-option" + (k === hiddenEl.value ? " selected" : "");
      opt.innerHTML = `<span class="fc-flag">${flag}</span><span>${k}</span>`;
      opt.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        hiddenEl.value = k;
        renderTrigger(k);
        Array.from(menu.children).forEach(c => c.classList.remove("selected"));
        opt.classList.add("selected");
        menu.classList.remove("open");
        renderActiveLeague();
      });
      menu.appendChild(opt);
    });

    trigger.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      menu.classList.toggle("open");
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", () => menu.classList.remove("open"));
  }

  function initForecastsPage() {
    initLeagueSelector();
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
      document.fonts.ready.then(renderActiveLeague);
    } else {
      renderActiveLeague();
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initForecastsPage);
  } else {
    initForecastsPage();
  }
})();
</script>
```
